description: Réseau d'assainissement des eaux - Collecteur is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Kanton Genf. Les collecteurs du réseau d'assainissement des eaux acheminent les eaux usées et météoriques depuis leur origine (bâtiments, industries, routes, parcelles agricoles, etc.) jusqu'aux stations d'épuration des eaux (STEP) ou jusqu'au milieu récepteur naturel (cours d'eau, lac, etc.). Ils constituent l'ossature du Cadastre du Réseau d'Assainissement des Eaux (CRAE). Coverage: Kanton Genf. The portal files it under the publisher Kanton Genf. It offers 9 resource(s) in API, CSV, GML, KML, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
